summary.tagline: A sweeping white sand arc between the headlands of the North Antrim Coast.
summary.seo_title: Visiting White Park Bay | North Antrim Coast Guide

travel.headline: Open Access at White Park Bay
travel.reservation: There is no formal entry reservation system for the beach itself. Access is managed by the National Trust; however, visitors should check official site updates for any localized closures or specific parking management at the Ballintoy trailhead before traveling.

days.title: North Antrim Coastal Exploration

stops.name: White Park Bay
stops.detail: Walk the white sandy arc between two headlands to observe ancient sand dunes and rich bird habitats. The secluded nature of the beach allows for quiet relaxation even during busier periods on the coast.

days.driving: Allow 10-20 minutes for local village transit; conditions vary
days.note: Pace your visit to account for tide levels which may affect the width of the walkable beach area.

intel.title: Secluded Coastal Entry
intel.text: The beach is located in the small village of Ballintoy. Access involves navigating the terrain between the headlands; check for current pedestrian path conditions.

intel.title: Year-Round Visitation
intel.text: The dunes provide varied habitats for animal life across the seasons. Quiet spots are generally available regardless of the time of day due to the bay's sweeping scale.

intel.title: Local Parking Availability
intel.text: Specific parking capacity in Ballintoy is not documented in provided evidence. Verify local signage and National Trust parking status upon arrival.

intel.title: Communication Gaps
intel.text: Mobile signal strength at the base of the headlands is unconfirmed. Download local maps of the County Antrim coast prior to arrival.

intel.title: Village Services
intel.text: The availability of fuel stations directly in Ballintoy is not specified in current sources. Ensure your vehicle is sufficiently fueled before leaving larger regional hubs.

plan.arrival: Arrive via the village of Ballintoy; secure a rental in Belfast or Derry/Londonderry before driving the coastal route to reach the trailhead.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for the paved roads leading to Ballintoy; check rental agreements for restrictions on narrow coastal lanes.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset from the western headland offers a seasonal view over the white sand arc.
